description: Hand-labeled one-day benchmark for segmentation evaluation (Phase 9.8.1).
limitation_note: This is a small (one-day, single-source) benchmark, not a gold standard. Its purpose is to catch regressions and guide tuning of PELT penalty beta and Leiden lambda, not to be statistically rigorous. Boundary labels are subjective; a different annotator might choose slightly different positions. The benchmark covers 4 Claude Code sessions (1711 events total) spanning ~13 hours of wall-clock time.
